bullets.text: Velachery residents told Deccan Chronicle that emergency pumping is no substitute for a permanent, scientifically-validated flood mitigation plan.

Sathiyam News reported that residential areas in Thiruvallur were flooded with sewage water, forcing residents indoors and causing venomous snakes to enter homes.
Urban Acres reported that severe Velachery flooding has triggered an IIT Madras study in Chennai to investigate drainage and water accumulation issues.
LiveChennai noted that the Tamil Nadu government is advancing DPR work for the proposed elevated corridor connecting Chennai Lighthouse with Thiru.Vi.Ka. Bridge.
DinaMani reported that Gummidipoondi MLA S. Vijayakumar inspected local rain-flood prevention works and drainage clearance operations.
Maalai Malar noted that water levels in Puzhel lake rose by three feet in a week as Water Resources Department officials closely monitor increasing inflows.
Siliconindia reported that US-based cloud provider Vultr plans to build a 20 MW AI data center in Chennai utilizing AMD Instinct GPUs.
Simply Wall Street covered the launch of CapitaLand Data Centre Chennai 01 in Ambattur, a planned INR 19,400 million development targeting 53 MW of gross power capacity.
The New Indian Express reported that Tamil Nadu has started procuring IT equipment to modernise courts under Phase III of the national e-Courts project.
Kalaignar Seithigal reported that DMK members staged protests over the delay in finding a missing seven-year-old girl in Villupuram district.
ABP Nadu reported that MP Dharani Vendan criticized the administration regarding the handling of the missing child case in Gingee.
DinaMani reported that Chief Minister Vijay launched an awareness campaign highlighting the critical importance of rainwater harvesting across the state.
